questions.title: Paragraph placement
questions.prompt: Place each missing paragraph into the gap where it best fits.
questions.passage:
Coined money had served European trade for centuries.

@@@1

What converted private bills into public currency was the cost of seventeenth-century war.

@@@2

By the eighteenth century, paper notes circulated alongside coin in most major economies.

placements.item: But coin was heavy, easily counterfeited, and forever in short supply where mints were distant.
Governments issued paper bills to pay armies, and merchants accepted them because the alternative was no payment at all.
